briefdescription.para: C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ basic test reporter methods.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the implementations for test_reporter_basic, the default concrete implementation of the test_reporter abstract interface. It formats and presents test results using printf-based standard output, accumulating output in an internal string buffer and supporting colour-coded diagnostics and multiple verbosity levels.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
